rule: plan 90 §90.3.1 with design general/topics/relevant, howdecided, prominent, howto and general/workup/choose; keys = signed EORS ob general (labs, imaging, anatomy, procedures, guidelines, screenings, workup — no EKG); PAEA Gynecological, Sexual, and Reproductive Health End of Rotation Exam Topic List, effective July 2026 (scratch/gsr.txt); Leader S10 ruling (selection recorded here, general.json written in S12). The mockup lists no ob presentations, so the workup list follows general/workup/choose: usual presentations of list conditions, plus presentations her guide has notes on.

labs.why: Labs are needed for ≥3 listed conditions (Prenatal management, Ectopic pregnancy, Gestational diabetes, Rh incompatibility, every condition under Infections, Amenorrhea, PCOS).

items.covers: Ectopic pregnancy; Abortion; Gestational trophoblastic disease; Amenorrhea (her guide: Diagnosis of Pregnancy)

items.item: Prenatal panel: CBC, blood type and Rh/antibody screen, rubella, HBsAg, HIV, syphilis, urine culture
items.covers: Prenatal management; Rh incompatibility (her guide: Rh Incompatibility)

items.item: Glucose challenge and glucose tolerance tests
Preeclampsia labs: urine protein/creatinine, platelets, creatinine, LFTs, LDH (HELLP)
items.covers: Hypertensive disorders of pregnancy; Eclampsia/HELLP; Pregnancy-induced hypertension

items.item: Aneuploidy screening: first-trimester screen, quad screen, cell-free DNA
items.covers: Prenatal management (her guide: 1st TM screen and quad screen rows)

items.item: Amenorrhea workup: hCG, TSH, prolactin, FSH/LH, testosterone/DHEA-S
Vaginal discharge: wet mount, KOH/whiff test, pH; NAAT for gonorrhea, chlamydia and trichomonas
items.covers: Bacterial vaginosis; Candida; Trichomoniasis; Gonorrhea; Chlamydia; Cervicitis; PID

items.item: Syphilis (RPR/VDRL, treponemal tests) and HSV PCR
Tumor markers: CA-125, AFP, β-hCG, inhibin
Urinalysis and urine culture in pregnancy
items.covers: Prenatal management (asymptomatic bacteriuria); her guide: Cystitis and Acute Pyelonephritis in pregnancy

items.item: Group B strep culture at 36–37 weeks

imaging.why: Imaging is needed for ≥3 listed conditions (Ectopic pregnancy, Placenta attachment disorders, Ovarian cysts/torsion, Leiomyoma, Breast neoplasm); her guide has her own ultrasound notes (Transvaginal U/S structures during the 1st TM, Endometrial Stripe).

items.item: Transvaginal ultrasound in early pregnancy (gestational sac, yolk sac, fetal pole) and the discriminatory zone
items.covers: Ectopic pregnancy; Abortion; Prenatal management (her guide: Transvaginal U/S structures during the 1st TM)

items.item: Obstetric ultrasound: dating, nuchal translucency, anatomy scan, placental location
items.covers: Prenatal management; Placenta attachment disorders; Multiple gestations (her guide: Prenatal Diagnosis/Care — nuchal translucency)
Ovarian torsion; Ovarian cysts; Leiomyoma; Ovarian neoplasm

items.item: Endometrial stripe thickness in postmenopausal bleeding
items.covers: Endometrial neoplasm; AUB (her guide: Endometrial Stripe)
Breast neoplasm; Fibrocystic breast disease; Breast abscess

anatomy.why: Anatomy is needed for ≥3 listed conditions: Mechanisms of delivery, Pelvic organ prolapse, Perineal laceration/episiotomy care, Ovarian torsion; her guide has pelvic-type and C-section incision pictures.

items.item: Female pelvic organs and their supports
items.covers: Pelvic organ prolapse; Urinary incontinence; Ovarian torsion
Labor dystocias; Mechanisms of delivery (her guide: pelvic types images)

items.item: Fetal lie, presentation and station; cardinal movements
items.covers: Normal labor and delivery; Breech presentation (her guide: Fundal Height/Fetal Station/Fetal Lie, Normal Labor & Delivery)
Mechanisms of delivery (her guide: Low Transverse, Low Vertical, Classical, Inverted T or J)

procedures.why: Procedures are needed for ≥3 listed conditions: Cervical dysplasia, Surgical contraception, Mechanisms of delivery, Perineal laceration/episiotomy care, Abortion.

items.item: Pap smear and HPV co-testing; colposcopy, LEEP and cone biopsy

items.covers: Hormonal contraception; Non-hormonal contraception; Emergency contraception

items.item: Normal vaginal delivery, operative vaginal delivery and cesarean delivery
items.covers: Normal labor and delivery; Mechanisms of delivery; Breech presentation

items.item: Bartholin gland I&D, Word catheter and marsupialization

guidelines.why: Guidelines apply to ≥3 listed conditions (cervical screening, contraception eligibility, hypertensive disorders of pregnancy, STI treatment).

items.item: ASCCP risk-based management of abnormal cervical screening
CDC US Medical Eligibility Criteria for Contraceptive Use
items.covers: Hormonal contraception; Emergency contraception (her guide: CONTRACEPTIVE METHODS, HORMONAL CONTRACEPTIVES)
Gonorrhea; Chlamydia; Syphilis; PID; Trichomoniasis; HSV

items.item: ACOG hypertensive disorders of pregnancy and low-dose aspirin

screenings.why: Screening applies to ≥3 listed conditions (Cervical neoplasm, Breast neoplasm, Gestational diabetes, Chlamydia/Gonorrhea, Postpartum depression, Violence and abuse).

items.covers: Every screening-eligible condition on the list

items.item: Breast cancer screening and BRCA risk assessment
Chlamydia, gonorrhea, syphilis, HIV and hepatitis B screening

items.covers: Violence and abuse (her guide: Spouse or Partner Neglect/Violence)
